ordinances.title: An Ordinance amending Ordinance No. 20, s. of 2024, otherwise known as “An Ordinance establishing the City College of Bayawan (CCB), defining its Mandate, and appropriating initial funds therefore”, to conform to the requirements of the Commission on Higher Education.
Road Closure of different streets for Bolanteros during the fiesta Baratilyo on February 3 to 24, 2025.
Road closure of Mabini and Martinez Streets from 12 noon of February 1, 2025 up to 4AM of February 5, 2025 (1PM-11PM) for the Alumni Homecoming for a cause activities of SAA.
Road closure along Telesforo Diao Street from Mormons church to Balay ni Bob on January 26, 2025 from 1PM to 11PM to celebrate the feast of Sr. Sto. Niño.
Road closure of J.P. Rizal Street, from corner Barangay Tinago Gymnasium and near DCCCO, Barangay Tinago on January 25, 2025 from 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM for the Celebration in Honor of Senior Sto. Niño.
An Ordinance Creating the College Librarian III Position for the City College of Bayawan.

Appropriating the amount of ₱6,552,000.00 representing savings in current appropriation of the general fund which is a portion of the lump-sum appropriation for proposed positions to be created and other compensation adjustments.

Appropriating the total amount of ₱408,430.00 to be funded from the savings in current appropriation of the General Fund for Office Supplies Expenses (Cell Card) is hereby reverted to the unappropriated balance of the General Fund and to appropriate the same amount for Telephone Expenses of various departments.
Road closure from February 1, 2025 to March 2025 for various activities in line with the celebration of the 2025 Tawo-Tawo Festival Season.
An Ordinance Naming the Bayawan City Health Office and Birthing Center as “Bayawan City Primary Care Facility” Located at Barangay Poblacion.

Amending the title and section 3 of Ordinance No. 71, series of 2024, otherwise known as “An Ordinance authorizing, confirming and ratifying the borrowing of the City of Bayawan in the amount of P800,000,000.00 to fund the construction of two-storey Bayawan City New Public Market Complex and approving the term loan agreement and the assignment of Deposit with hold-out and control agreement.”
Temporarily closing certain roads for the Tawo-tawo Festival Season and CVIRAA Sports Meet 2025.
An Ordinance creating Seven (7) Faculty Positions for the City College of Bayawan.

An Ordinance adopting Section 30, Article V of RA 12001, otherwise known as the “Real Property Valuation and Assessment Reform Act” (RPVARA), authorizing the grant of tax amnesty on Real Property Taxes and Special Levies on Real Property within the Territorial Jurisdiction of the City of Bayawan effective for the period of two years or until July 5, 2025.

An Ordinance institutionalizing at least 10% allocation from the National Tax Allotment by the City of Bayawan for the implementation of agriculture, livestock and fisheries development programs and projects.
Road closure on March 14-15, 2025 for the Kasikas sa Boulevard in celebration of the Tawo-tawo Festival Season and CVIRAA Sports Meet.
Appropriating the amount of P2,370,000.00 to be funded from the un-appropriated balances of the General Fund amounting to P103,745,236.57 for the Acquisition of Lot for LGU Development Projects.
